title: End both account sessions while an unsent market allocation is open
description: Four commanders enter a real development campaign. A second device ends the owner's sessions through Google confirmation while the first remains on its campaign page. Partial market intent clears without sending; an unrelated player's private view remains unchanged. Fresh authentication recovers the original identity and authoritative allocation. Fixed admission/catalogue clocks and developer entitlement are explicit harness controls, not hosted acceptance. No membership fault, active Leave, market order or production tick is injected.
